title: Blank the Spire: a few users are worth a lot more than a million tokens
author: unwittingyeti
selftext:
Blank the Spire (my create-your-own-class mod for Slay the Spire 2) has been slowly accumulating a few users over the past week and I can't possibly overstate how valuable having a few users is. Claude is very convincing and it is easy to think that it has covered all of its bases, but even in the age of AI no plan completely survives contact with the user... here are the biggest gains so far:  
  
1. OTHER AI PLATFORMS -- I thought by testing my thingy on an openAI, Anthropic and openrouter key that I had pretty much covered all of my bases. I wasn't able to test on every single provider out there because my last functioning credit card looks at me and says "o-o-okay.. I'll try my best..." when I tell him I need to link him to another AI provider.  
  
It turns out every provider has its own tangled web of formatting weirdness and error messages that is impossible to find out from the ever-changing documentation. Just getting error messages from people and chasing them down has been invaluable. Shoutout to the guy who kept trying after 17 failures in a row. You're awesome, whoever you are. 

2. I FORGOT A LANDING PAGE -- I figured my one-button minimalist approach would be a hit.... but it just made people leave the site XD Clood is just bad at people-shaped problems. Almost like some guy who went to business school and memorized every book but since he spent every moment of school in the library not talking to a human being he became totally detached from the human element. 

Hopefully more lessons coming soon! If I learn em I'll share em.
